with o as (select kalshi_order_id, market_ticker, created_at, quantity oq, limit_price lp from live_orders where strategy='Jmmsell10' and action='buy' and created_at >= '2026-10-04T17:54:06Z'),
f as (select o.market_ticker, sum(f.quantity) fq, round(sum(f.quantity*f.price)::numeric/nullif(sum(f.quantity),0),1) fpx, max(o.lp) lp, max(o.oq) oq, min(o.created_at) ordered, min(f.filled_at) first_fill, max(f.filled_at) last_fill, max(f.side) fside from fills f join o using(kalshi_order_id) group by 1),
nw as (select distinct on (p.market_ticker) p.market_ticker, p.realized_pnl, coalesce(p.quantity_fp,p.quantity::numeric) q, p.captured_at from positions p join f using(market_ticker) order by p.market_ticker, p.captured_at desc)
select f.market_ticker, f.oq, f.fq, f.lp, f.fpx, f.fside, to_char(f.ordered,'MM-DD HH24:MI') ordered, to_char(f.first_fill,'MM-DD HH24:MI') ff, to_char(f.last_fill,'MM-DD HH24:MI') lf, to_char(nw.captured_at,'MM-DD HH24:MI') snap, round(nw.realized_pnl,4) realized, nw.q from f left join nw using(market_ticker) order by nw.realized_pnl nulls first
